page.overview:
Who is Abumojandis?

Abumojandis was the aide to Bannerjee, and was one of the Fremen Naibs accused by Bijaz as a traitor against the Atreides Empire.

In a deleted scene from Dune Messiah, Abumojandis is present when Paul Atreides and Bannerjee use a distrans recorder to extract the names of the conspirators from Bijaz. Upon being named, he attempts to assassinate Paul with a cutterray, but Bannerjee sacrifices himself stepping in the way of his cutterray while Paul himself hurls a knife, killing Abumojandis. He is also stated to originate from Balak Sietch.
